metadataRaw.description:
Looking for relief from sciatica without surgery? 

In this video, Dr. Rowe breaks down the best at-home exercises to help relieve nerve pain fast.

This simple, step-by-step guide is designed to get you the best possible results. These movements work by stretching and strengthening key muscles, boosting blood flow along the sciatic nerve pathway, and accelerating your recovery.

If you’re dealing with a herniated or bulging disc and worried about surgery, watch this video first—it may help you avoid an unnecessary procedure!
